title_cyr: Абер ми дојде од мојто либе
title_latin: Aber mi dojde od mojto libe
title_en: News Came to Me from My Love
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: The gender of the beloved is ambiguous in the Macedonian text ('либе' is neuter); I rendered it as 'him' (my reading, since the song seems sung by a woman).

lines.cyr: Абер ми дојде од мојто либе,

lines.cyr: јас да идам, јас да го видам.
